title: Alpha v4.4.0.2
summary: Alpha has been retired. This last release (4.4.0.2) switches Alpha off: its 13 mods are replaced by placeholders that add nothing to the game. Back up your worlds before updating: blocks that Alpha added turn into empty air, and once a world has been saved that way they do not come back. See the changelog on the Wiki for what to do if you installed by hand or run a server.
